excerpt.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
excerpt.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

texts.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
texts.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

sections.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空是一种需要专门征服或攻克的不利环境。而对我们而言，这就是家园。

千百年来，我们的物种栖息在数座独立围绕我们三星系统内恒星的空间站之上。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站不得而知。

一些人猜测与我们一同围绕着恒星的破碎行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相仍然扑朔迷离。

自我们发明，又或者叫发现，可以跨越空间站之间虚空的太空航行能力才过去了几个世纪。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。随着第一台装有[GetStartingDrivePlural]的舰船竣工，我们的这些居住站就团结在了同一面旗帜之下。
sections.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting the suns in our trinary system. Whether our predecessors or someone else built them, we do not know.

Some speculate that the shattered planetary remnants orbiting the stars alongside us are remnants of our creators' homeworld, but the truth remains elusive.

Only a few centuries have passed since the invention, or rediscovery, of spaceflight capable of bridging the gap between our stations. Suspicion and mistrust gradually yielded to trade and cooperation. With the construction of our first[GetStartingDrivePlural]-capable ship, the habitats had united under one flag.

sections.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们的物种分别栖息在围绕我们恒星的数座空间站之上。究竟是我们的先行者还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的身体结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，有记录的历史却完全没有提到这一点。有些人推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

只在几个世纪前，我们才发明了足以在我们空间站之间往来的太空旅行方式——又或者叫再发明，取决于你问的人是谁。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。在我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]发明之时，这些居住站已经团结在了同一面旗帜之下。
sections.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our physical features indicate we originated on a planet, but recorded history makes no mention of it. Some speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet found beneath one of our stations is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

It has only been a few centuries since spaceflight allowing travel between our stations was invented - or rediscovered, depending on who you ask. Suspicion and mistrust gradually gave way to trade and mutual cooperation. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], the habitats had united under one flag.

sections.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，意识统一的我们栖息在数座空间站之上，每座都各自环绕着三星系统中的一颗恒星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的破碎的行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这些分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。
sections.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we resided on several space stations with a single mind, in orbit of the suns in our trinary system. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the shattered planetary remnants in orbit with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

After rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们统一的意识被分割在数座空间站之中，每个都各自环绕着一颗不同的行星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的一个空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这几个分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。
sections.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we existed as a single mind, separated by several space stations in orbit of our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet in orbit along with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

After rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.
